Title: Add Markdown export for a single note

I keep notes in the CLI but want to share one of them as a standalone .md file.

Request: `python -m tinydb_demo export <id> -o note.md` writes:
- `# <title>` as the first line
- body as-is
- a `tags:` line as hashtags when the note has tags

Acceptance:
- exit code 0 and the file exists
- missing id prints an error and exits 1
- covered by at least one pytest case
